title: The Antikythera Mechanism Episode 9 - Making The Epicyclic Pin and Slot Gearing
summary: Clickspring makes the pin-and-slot epicyclic gearing of the Antikythera Mechanism, the module modelling the Moon's variable motion in the Greek theory, by hand.
why: Recommended as a beautiful explanation of how the mechanism models the Moon's uneven motion.

quote.text: the video does a better job of explaining it (within the first minute)
